_doc: Collision INTENT (designed, not simulated) for arm A (rows) vs arm B (columns). Key 'A_MOVE|B_MOVE'. outcome: swords | A_taps_B | B_taps_A | both_tap | miss (visual outcome; the rules engine may still count a landed attack on a 'miss'). touch: what touches what. calibrate: end poses to set by hand, as '<arm>:<MOVE>:<pose>' where pose is end (the move's end key), end@X (a contact variant of that end pose for opponent move X), stop (a feint's stop/retreat pose), band (a low sweep's hand height + blade pitch). group: entries in _calibration. Sides: L = A's left = B's right, R = A's right = B's left. Keys starting with '_' are metadata.

_calibration.C1: ATTACK_HIGH end (anchor) vs BLOCK_MIDDLE guard hand: tip stops on the top of the gripper (0-1 cm), never drives down
_calibration.C2: BLOCK_HIGH contact variant vs the opponent's ATTACK_HIGH end: bar just touches the final blade mid-blade; grippers >= 8 cm apart
_calibration.C3: High bind: both ATTACK_HIGH ends together: blades cross mid-blade over the centre, hilts >= 8 cm; shorten both slams equally if not
_calibration.C4: FEINT_HIGH stop pose: (a) meets the opponent's landed ATTACK_HIGH blade flat and light; (b) stops >= 3 cm above BLOCK_HIGH's bar, a centre guard hand and the mirror feint
_calibration.C5: Low-sweep band (ATTACK_LOW_LR/RL hand z + blade pitch, windup included): blade passes >= 2 cm under the opponent's low gripper at every bearing (opponent ATTACK_LOW_* ends, FEINT_LEFT/RIGHT stops)
_calibration.C6: Low sweep into its guard: ATTACK_LOW_LR end pan vs opponent BLOCK_LEFT and BLOCK_MIDDLE stops 2-3 cm before the hanging blade; the guard's contact variant hangs its blade so it crosses the sweep line >= 6 cm ahead of the attacker's hilt (this also clears the windup on the off side and keeps two same-side guards >= 4 cm apart). ATTACK_LOW_RL vs BLOCK_RIGHT/MIDDLE by mirror, then verified
_calibration.C7: Low bind: ATTACK_LOW_LR end vs the opponent's ATTACK_LOW_RL end on the same side: both stop ~5 deg short so the blades cross mid-blade, hilts >= 8 cm
_calibration.C8: Crossing sweeps (no end pose): the crossing frame of two opposite low sweeps; C5 keeps the blades off the grippers, the blades brush flat at the centre; lengthen t_slash on both if the brush is hard
_calibration.C9: FEINT_LEFT/RIGHT stop pose: (a) cocked blade placed so the opponent's same-side sweep brushes its flat in the last 2-3 deg; (b) >= 3 cm clear of the guard on its line and of the mirror feint on the same side. FEINT_RIGHT by mirror
_calibration.C10: BLOCK_HIGH vs BLOCK_HIGH: two level bars, parallel, ~5 cm apart in x: verify >= 3 cm

ATTACK_HIGH|ATTACK_HIGH.touch: both chop blades cross mid-blade above the centre (the high bind)

ATTACK_HIGH|ATTACK_LOW_LR.why: A's chop comes down at the centre ~15 cm above B's low hand; B's sweep passes under A's raised arm. Both land by rule; both flinches sell it

ATTACK_HIGH|ATTACK_LOW_RL.why: A's chop comes down at the centre ~15 cm above B's low hand; B's sweep passes under A's raised arm. Both land by rule; both flinches sell it

ATTACK_HIGH|FEINT_HIGH.touch: B's half-swung feint blade meets A's landed chop blade, flat; B then flops back
ATTACK_HIGH|FEINT_HIGH.why: attack beats feint: the feint has committed 60% into the same high line, so the blades meet; reads as the chop catching the hesitating blade

ATTACK_HIGH|FEINT_LEFT.why: A lands by rule (attack beats feint) but chop and low feint are on different heights; nothing is under the blade

ATTACK_HIGH|FEINT_RIGHT.why: A lands by rule (attack beats feint) but chop and low feint are on different heights; nothing is under the blade

ATTACK_HIGH|BLOCK_HIGH.touch: A's chop blade lands mid-blade on B's level bar
ATTACK_HIGH|BLOCK_HIGH.why: the bar is the high-line block; closest gripper-to-gripper case, both hands high and forward

ATTACK_HIGH|BLOCK_LEFT.why: side guard is ~9 cm beside the chop line; A lands by rule in the gap, B's flinch sells it

ATTACK_HIGH|BLOCK_RIGHT.why: side guard is ~9 cm beside the chop line; A lands by rule in the gap, B's flinch sells it

ATTACK_HIGH|BLOCK_MIDDLE.touch: A's chop tip taps the top of B's sword hand (gripper/hilt) which sits at the centre under the high line
ATTACK_HIGH|BLOCK_MIDDLE.why: a hanging guard leaves the high line open and puts the blocker's hand right under the chop: 'over the guard, onto the hand'; this is the chop's anchor target

ATTACK_LOW_LR|ATTACK_HIGH.why: B's chop comes down at the centre ~15 cm above A's low hand; A's sweep passes under B's raised arm. Both land by rule; both flinches sell it

ATTACK_LOW_LR|ATTACK_LOW_LR.touch: the blades brush flat as they cross at the centre mid-sweep; each then lands in air on its own side
ATTACK_LOW_LR|ATTACK_LOW_LR.why: opposite sweeps at one height must cross; both land by rule. No end pose fixes this: the band rule keeps each blade off the other gripper

ATTACK_LOW_LR|ATTACK_LOW_RL.touch: both sweep blades end crossed in an X just ahead of the hilts on side R (the low bind)
ATTACK_LOW_LR|ATTACK_LOW_RL.why: same-direction sweeps ending on the same side: same line, clash; hands only ~7 cm apart

ATTACK_LOW_LR|FEINT_HIGH.why: A lands by rule (attack beats feint) but chop and low feint are on different heights; nothing is under the blade

ATTACK_LOW_LR|FEINT_LEFT.touch: A's sweep, in its last degrees, brushes the flat of B's cocked feint blade
ATTACK_LOW_LR|FEINT_LEFT.why: B's feint hand sits on the side where A's sweep lands; the blade must pass under the gripper (band) and only catch the cocked blade

ATTACK_LOW_LR|FEINT_RIGHT.why: B's feint is on the side where A's sweep starts; the sweep leaves it behind and lands in air (A wins by rule, B's flinch sells it); the feint hand is inside the sweep band so the blade must pass under it

ATTACK_LOW_LR|BLOCK_HIGH.why: the bar is high, the sweep passes under it; the sweep lands by rule

ATTACK_LOW_LR|BLOCK_LEFT.touch: A's sweep blade stops against the flat of B's hanging guard blade (on the sweep's landing side)
ATTACK_LOW_LR|BLOCK_LEFT.why: guard on the sweep's line: the sweep must stop short of the hanging blade instead of driving through it

ATTACK_LOW_LR|BLOCK_RIGHT.why: guard is on the side where the sweep starts; the sweep leaves it and lands in air on the open side (A lands by rule). The windup and opening whip must clear the guard's hanging tip

ATTACK_LOW_LR|BLOCK_MIDDLE.touch: A's sweep blade stops against the flat of B's hanging guard blade (intercepts the sweep mid-way)
ATTACK_LOW_LR|BLOCK_MIDDLE.why: guard on the sweep's line: the sweep must stop short of the hanging blade instead of driving through it
